title: Investment in Agricultural and Rural Development

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the role and characteristics of agricultural and rural development investment
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the role and characteristics of agricultural and rural development investment, organizational forms of management activities, criteria for selecting and making investment decisions on market, technology, capital.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing financial and economic aspects of investment projects
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the contents of financial and economic analysis of investment projects in agricultural and rural development and apply them to make investment decisions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basic issues in project evaluation and management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand basic issues in project evaluation and management in agricultural and rural development to effectively utilize investment funds.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying knowledge and basic skills in market analysis, technology selection, capital calculation, financial and economic analysis of investment projects
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students apply their knowledge and basic skills in market analysis, technology selection, capital calculation, financial and economic analysis of investment projects.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Independently solving practical problems through information collection and project development
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students independently solve specific practical problems by collecting information and developing investment projects in agricultural and rural development.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Working independently and taking personal responsibility
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have the ability to work independently and take personal responsibility.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Self-assessing quality of work results after completion
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can self-assess the quality of work results after completion.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Continuous lifelong learning to adapt to changing conditions
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have the ability to continuously learn throughout life to adapt to changing environmental conditions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Planning, coordinating, managing resources, evaluating and improving efficiency of activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have the ability to plan, coordinate, manage resources, evaluate and improve the efficiency of activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Social responsibility and professional ethics in evaluating investment projects
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have social responsibility and professional ethics when evaluating investment projects in agricultural and rural development.
